name: brand-research-brain
description: Learn from brands, build linked Shopify knowledge, and share readable HTML with optional detailed growth chapters.

interface.longDescription: Understand a business, learn concrete practices and accumulate linked Shopify knowledge. Share readable HTML with concise case learning and full growth chapters when requested. Existing research can be presented without new data-provider calls.
defaultPrompt: Create my Shopify research and learning Brain.
Study this website: explain the business, teach me three practices, and save Markdown learning plus a concise Chinese HTML digest.
Research this brand's social media, creators and SEO using public sources, then save concise growth learning.
Present this completed growth study in HTML, including its stages, concrete examples and lessons.
